Name: Farm Animal Facelift
Author: siamece
Description:
[u][size=5][img]https://i.imgur.com/BBeI8e1.png[/img]﻿[/size][/u]
﻿﻿This mod edits each barn + coop animal, smoothing their appearances and adding breed/colour options.
Part of my Facelift series that also includes [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7116]Vanilla Facelift[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9097]Pet Facelift[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8591]SVE Facelift[/url].

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ are required. Just hit download & unzip/extract the file into your Stardew mods folder!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/OiRp2mm.gif[/img]  [img]https://i.imgur.com/qzFctsW.gif[/img]  [img]https://i.imgur.com/M123nAp.gif[/img]

Files: 
[b][size=3]Main:[/size][/b] choose the skin you'd like for each animal in the config. all pigs will be tamworth, all rabbits blonde blaze, etc.
[b][size=3]Skins:[/size][/b] randomizes the skin of each animal on purchase - use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21612]this mod[/url] to re-randomize if you install it midsave & want to reroll the skins.
[size=3][b]AT[/b]:[/size] requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]. use the scissors sold at Robin's to choose the skin for each animal. can be used alongside the Main or Skins version.
[b][size=3]Mobile:[/size][/b] Android SMAPI is a broken as of rn but yknow. just in case lol

[u]                                                                                                                                                                                 [/u]
[size=4]
[u][img]https://i.imgur.com/uUcgk6G.png[/img][/u][/size]

There is a config guide included in the mod, but i'll write them out here too. This is only for the CP version.
Use the option[b] 'vanilla'[/b] to turn off my edits entirely for each animal. This allows you to install other CP mods that edit the animals without conflict.

[b]White Cow:   [/b]    white, solid, holstein, vanilla
[b]Brown Cow:[/b]      brown, solid, black, highland, void, vanilla
[b]Sheep:[/b]               suffolk, white, black, void, bighorn, vanilla
[b]Pig: [/b]                   pink, white, tamworth, black, brown spots, black spots, void, vanilla
[b]Goat: [/b]                 blonde, white, black, brown, black blaze, white blaze, void, vanilla
[b]Duck:[/b]                 mallard, brown, black, white, void, vanilla
[b]Rabbit:[/b]               blonde, brown, white, black, brown spots, black spots, blonde blaze, brown blaze, black blaze, void, vanilla
[b]Void Chicken:[/b]   void, space, vanilla
[b]Ostrich:     [/b]        brown, void, vanilla
[b]Dinosaur:  [/b]        green, void, vanilla
[b]Chicken:[/b]            edited, vanilla
